events.title: Yemeni government and Houthis trade attacks across several fronts, both claim heavy losses
events.caption: Government forces, in a counteroffensive they call Operation Dawn of Yemen, say they hit Houthi positions in Lahij, Taiz, Marib, al-Jawf, Hajjah and al-Bayda and killed or wounded about 190 fighters. The Houthis say Saudi-backed forces launched 109 air and missile attacks and claim strikes on Riyadh and an Aramco facility. Al Jazeera could not verify either side's claims. events.caption: The ISW/CTP Iran Update of Nov 13 assesses that the Houthis launched a combined-arms offensive on Nov 11 and advanced about 12 km southwest from al Majza into al Shatt and al Sarih Junction, Madaribah wa al Arah District, on Nov 12, likely toward Jabal Kharaz. It says Yemeni government-aligned forces, with STC-aligned brigades reinforcing and Saudi aircraft providing air support, halted the advance and recaptured territory. This is an analyst assessment from open sources; the Houthi military spokesman separately claims ballistic-missile strikes on Saudi-led forces at Khorz in Lahij on Nov 12-13. events.title: Six Palestinians killed in Israeli strikes and shelling across Gaza, medics say
events.caption: Medical sources and witnesses told Middle East Eye six Palestinians were killed and about 20 wounded on Nov 13. They say a second strike in Deir el-Balah hit people helping the wounded from an earlier attack, and artillery shelled the area around the al-Qastal Towers east of the city and eastern Gaza City. Casualty figures come from medics, Wafa and Gaza's health ministry; no Israeli statement on these incidents was found. Marker is at Deir el-Balah, not each strike.

events.title: Iran says three tankers hit mines and caught fire in and near Hormuz
events.caption: Iran's IRGC Navy says two tankers hit a naval mine in the south of the strait after switching off radar and positioning systems on an 'unauthorised route'; Iran's army navy says a third tanker, with tracking off, caught fire and stopped after hitting a mine in a 'prohibited zone' east of the strait. No vessel names were given and no independent confirmation was found. The US says it has cleared the main routes of mines and the strait is open to shipping (via Al Jazeera). Marker is at Khasab, not the exact position.

UKMTO counted at least seven tanker attacks in the week to Nov 11 and puts transits about 65% below pre-war. The UN says at least 25 seafarers have died since February. The US says routes are cleared and the strait is open; Iran says it stays shut until its conditions are met.

stats.headline: Paused, two tracks
stats.text: Qatari mediators back in Tehran Oct 30 (Reuters). Vance letter to Rezaei proposed direct talks; Iran has not replied and holds to its seven conditions (Tasnim via ISW). Trump says the outreach was about medical supplies. CENTCOM's Adm. Cooper briefed Trump on military options at the White House (WSJ via CNBC).
